column1: Table 2.1a: Estimated number of taxpayers, amounts of gains and tax liabilities by size of gain in the 2024 to 2025 tax year for individuals
This table provides additional gain band breakdowns based around the Annual Exempt Amount (AEA) for individuals in the 2024 to 2025 tax year.
The AEA for individuals in the 2024 to 2025 tax year was £3,000. It was £6,000 in the previous tax year and £12,300 in the three years before that.
Equivalent information for trusts is reported in Table 2.1b.
Gains are after the deduction of losses plus attributed gains but before deduction of the Annual Exempt Amount.
Figures only include taxpayers who have a CGT liability.
Provisional figures from previous publications are updated with new information from late and amended tax returns.
Numbers of taxpayers are measured in thousands, amounts of gain and tax are measured in £ millions.
Totals may not sum due to rounding.
The statistics for the tax year presented in this table are provisional.
